page: Microsoft Azure DC4as_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage options, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the DC4as_v6 is positioned as a general-purpose virtual machine. It is suitable for workloads such as web serving, small databases, and general application hosting. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, making it a reliable option within its hardware class for resource-dense, non-burstable workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure DC4as_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine from the DCasv6 family, powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures stable performance without the resource sharing typical of burstable instances. This hardware profile makes the DC4as_v6 well-suited for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application hosting, and moderate database tasks that require consistent compute resources without the need for local high-speed storage or hardware acceleration.
